    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:

        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:

        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:prod

      # build jobs have separate filesystems; both unit shards need each lockfile.
      - name: Install locked Admin dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/admin-ts

      - name: Install locked Supplier dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/supplier-ts

      - name: Install locked Kefu dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/kefu-ts

      - name: Install locked Uni dependencies for customer SFC unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/uniapp-ts

      - name: Run both TypeScript configurations
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Begin isolated native child diagnostic capture
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts --begin

        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm run test:unit -- --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/2 --reporter=verbose --reporter=json --outputFile.json=unit-shard-results.json 2>&1 | tee unit-shard.log

          npx --no-install tsx scripts/route-parity-audit.ts |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({authority:r.phpRoot,...r.totals}));})'

    services:

        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: finance_test

        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U finance_test -d cinashop_finance_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts

      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Execute isolated PostgreSQL 16 ORM and migration catalog audit
        run: npm run audit:orm

      - name: Verify NOT VALID generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:not-valid

      - name: Verify sequence generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:sequences

      - name: Measure FK statistics candidates on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:work-fk:statistics-scale

        env:

        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:

  uni-core:
    name: UniApp type, runtime and three-platform build execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: view/uniapp-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: view/uniapp-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify complete frontend gate partition
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/ci-migration-gates.test.cjs

      - name: Run type, test and build contract
        run: npm run typecheck && npm run test:toolchain && npm run test:admzip && npm run test:express-qs && npm run test:jest-jsdom-once && npm run test:d3-advisories && npm run build:h5 && npm run build:mp-weixin && npm run build:app && npm run test:build-artifacts && npm run test:automator-qr && npm run test:runtime-i18n

      - name: Verify frontend dependency security regressions
        run: node --test ../common/toolchain-security.test.mjs

    name: UniApp editorial author and PHP style execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: view/uniapp-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: view/uniapp-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify complete frontend gate partition
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/ci-migration-gates.test.cjs

        run: npm run test:diy-editorial-author && npm run test:diy-community-author && npm run test:diy-promotion-author && npm run test:diy-coupon-author && npm run test:diy-points-author && npm run test:diy-presale-author && npm run test:diy-combination-author && npm run test:diy-bargain-author && npm run test:diy-seckill-author && npm run test:diy-live-broadcast-author

    name: ${{ matrix.name }} build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Admin
            directory: admin-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: PC
            directory: pc-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: Supplier
            directory: supplier-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: Kefu
            directory: kefu-ts
            command: npm test && npm run build
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: view/${{ matrix.directory }}/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install locked Uni dependencies for actual carousel projection
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts'
        working-directory: view/uniapp-ts
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run type, test and build contract
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: ${{ matrix.command }}

      - name: Verify frontend dependency security regressions
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: node --test ../common/toolchain-security.test.mjs

        if: matrix.directory == 'kefu-ts' || matrix.directory == 'pc-ts'
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: npm audit --audit-level=low --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org

        working-directory: view/admin-ts
        run: npm run test:diy-footer && npm run test:diy-presentation && npm run test:diy-customer-service && npm run test:diy-page-settings && npm run test:diy-navigation && npm run test:diy-carousel && npm run test:diy-list && npm run test:diy-state-author && npm run test:diy-editorial-author && npm run test:diy-commerce-author && npm run test:diy-community-author && npm run test:diy-follow && npm run test:diy-editorial && npm run test:diy-community && npm run test:diy-promotion && npm run test:diy-coupon && npm run test:diy-points && npm run test:diy-presale && npm run test:diy-combination && npm run test:diy-bargain && npm run test:diy-seckill && npm run test:diy-live-broadcast && npm run test:config-classes && npm run test:browser-log && npm run test:exceptions && npm run test:profile && npm run test:platform-menu-rules && npm run test:express-author && npm run test:level-author && npm run test:user-label-author && npm run test:store-author && npm run test:staff-author && npm run test:delivery-author && npm run test:group-author && npm run test:unit-author

      - name: Verify grouped Admin navigation
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts'
        working-directory: view/admin-ts
        run: npm run test:admin-navigation

      - name: Verify Admin user filters
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts'
        working-directory: view/admin-ts
        run: npm run test:user-directory && npm run test:membership-rights

      - name: Verify Admin withdrawal directory
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts'
        working-directory: view/admin-ts
        run: npm run test:extract-directory

      - name: Verify complete product-label author and recovery
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts'
        working-directory: view/admin-ts
        run: npm run test:product-label-author

      - name: Verify current ECharts tooltip paths
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts' || matrix.directory == 'supplier-ts'
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: node --test ../common/echarts-tooltip.test.mjs

  secret-scan:
    name: Repository secret scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out full repository history
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js for isolated scanner canaries
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"

      - name: Install checksum-pinned Gitleaks
        env:
          GITLEAKS_VERSION: "8.29.0"
          GITLEAKS_LINUX_X64_SHA256: "39e07ad810336fd0ae80d0bd61c60d0521f628173e7583583b5df4a38738522c"
        run: |
          archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
          curl --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-max-time 120 \
            --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 40 \
            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v${GITLEAKS_VERSION}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz" \
            --output "$archive"
          echo "${GITLEAKS_LINUX_X64_SHA256}  ${archive}" | sha256sum --check
          tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" gitleaks
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks" version

      - name: Verify exact historical ignores retain new-secret detection
        run: node workers-ts/scripts/verify-gitleaks-reviewed-findings.mjs --binary "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"

      - name: Scan current and historical commits with pinned Gitleaks
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks" git --redact --verbose --no-banner
